name: vt-snapshot-unavailable

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan
owed by the E2 vt plan

description: A VT worker that cannot answer (down, or hung — a missed heartbeat is a dead worker, D17/F20): a snapshot that cannot be taken does not advance the commit point and raises vt_unavailable, the core's operator alert, which is not a VT error code (C6 decision 2). This is the C4-side control view; the alert itself rides C6 — alert.raised and broker.health — not this socket, so the C4 messages here are the healthy handshake and grid, and the description records the failure the core observes when the worker stops answering. Meanwhile the recording keeps every frame and a restore reads them back from the commit point, but a session that must reattach (a core restart, a lone data-socket loss) waits for a snapshot at most snapshot.wait_sec, then gives its grid up: record-only realign, and the stale flow with cause grid_lost (continuity-state top). The recording side is graded by the U2 core (owed), and this fixture invents no cross-socket machinery. The U4 worker is owed.
